reason: Fixed D6 by adding a new closed reason 'unlinked-workspace-package': boundaryReason now also indexes supplied directory roots, so a bare/scoped package specifier whose package-name tail matches a supplied directory is named (with every matching root quoted, ambiguity stated) instead of being dismissed as external, and unlinkedInputSites emits it.
